The brew stand shows the roast picker and the new wake-power hint for the open-roast cold recipes (cold_brew_concentrate, protein_cold_brew), but START routes through _begin_cold_steep into ColdBrewFridge.start(recipe, bean, method), which stores no roast. collect() re-resolves via BrewFlow.resolve without chosen_roast_kind, so every collected cold cup brews at the medium default no matter which roast the player picked. Current data hides the loss (the crossfitter cure accepts medium at 0.8 resistance, and the 85 score ceiling keeps the cup below the perfect-tier splash whose radius the roast scales), but the stand now promises the choice matters; a light-only cold cure would break that promise. Fix: pass the chosen roast kind into fridge.start, store it in the steep state (save_state/load_state), resolve it in collect; write the failing test first.
Evidence: game/scripts/minigames/brew_stand_view.gd _begin_cold_steep calls fridge.start(_recipe, _bean, _flow.method) and drops _chosen_roast_kind(); game/scripts/city/cold_brew_fridge.gd start/collect/save_state hold _recipe and _bean only, and collect() calls BrewFlow.resolve(_recipe, _bean, library) with no roast argument; game/tests/integration/test_brew_stand.gd test_the_roast_choice_rides_the_brewed_cup covers the roast choice only on the frappuccino (minigame) path.

tasks.title: Decide how a player learns the Sleep Jam stage-height delivery
tasks.details:
A CoffeeCup's physics body flies a straight line from start to landing (coffee_cup.gd lerps global_position; the parabola is visual-only via visual.position). The Sleep Jam stage CollisionShape2D sits at local (0,-140), size 220x120, so the stage body spans world y -80..-200 above the band origin. A street-level throw passes under the boards and can never wake the band; the aim assist does not snap to it (StaticBody2D, not in the sleepwalkers group) and serve does not target it. The only working live delivery is to walk beside the stage at stage height (player at band + (0,-140) + (-150,0), throw east), which the test now does, mirroring test_sleep_jam.gd STAGE_LOCAL_OFFSET. That spot is undiscoverable for a player without a hint or a visual cue. Design call for Niko: accept the side-stage throw and telegraph it (a floor marker or a line from the band), or lower/capture the stage collision so an ordinary throw arcs true. Left as a finding; no code patched.
Evidence: game/scripts/projectiles/coffee_cup.gd _physics_process (straight-line lerp, visual-only arc); game/scenes/bosses/sleep_jam_band.tscn line 42 (stage at (0,-140)); game/tests/integration/test_sleep_jam.gd:14 STAGE_LOCAL_OFFSET; east finale delivery in test_v1_playthrough_east.gd _deliver_cup_to_the_stage

Resolution: Decision (delegated by Niko 2026-11-20): Make street-level throws, aim-assist, serve reach, and cure weapons hit the raised Sleep Jam stage naturally, plus draw a subtle chalk arc cue in front of the stage while performing. Implemented SleepJamBand.aim_point() returning the stage center, CureDelivery.target_point() used across splash/cone/drip/serve/aim-assist, Player._reachable_sleepwalker_candidates() extended to elevated targets exposing aim_point(), stage hitbox widened slightly toward the stage lip, and regression test test_a_street_level_player_throw_wakes_the_band in test_sleep_jam.gd.
